heading: WebP Compressor Online for Smaller Website Images
introduction:
Website images play an important role in how visitors experience a page. Product photographs, banners, illustrations and other graphics help people understand products and services. However, large image files can increase page weight and make websites slower to load.

WebP is a modern image format developed for web use. It supports lossy and lossless compression, along with transparency and animation. Many website owners use WebP to prepare images that can be delivered efficiently to visitors.

Even when an image is already saved in WebP format, there may be opportunities to reduce its size further. File Compresser provides a WebP Compressor that lets you re-encode supported still WebP images, compare file sizes and review image quality directly in your browser.

You do not need to install software or upload your photographs to an external server. Your device handles the image processing.

sections.heading: What Is a WebP Compressor?
sections.body:
A WebP compressor is an image optimization tool that changes how a WebP image is encoded to manage its file size.

Depending on the selected settings, the tool can create a smaller image while keeping its original dimensions. It can also help prepare images for different website requirements.

However, compression does not always make an existing WebP image smaller. Many WebP files are already optimized, and further encoding may produce little benefit.
File Compresser checks the actual result. If ordinary same-format compression does not create a smaller suitable file, the original is retained unchanged.
